A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] individual was the '''mother''' of [[Kitster Chanchani Banai]]. As Kitster's father, [[Rakir Banai]], was a well-known [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]], the mother and son were targeted by his enemies. When Kitster was four, the two were kidnapped and sold separately into slavery.
